title: Planning an API Project knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Planning an API Project”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Gathering functional requirements” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Planning an API Project”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which approach best supports advanced FastAPI engineering here? (Planning an API Project)
options: Use a documented contract, test edge cases and verify behavior under the relevant constraints
Assume one process-local variable synchronizes every replica
questions.answer_key: Use a documented contract, test edge cases and verify behavior under the relevant constraints
questions.explanation: Advanced extensions still need stable contracts, boundaries, tests and verified failure behavior.
